## 4. Square Booking Events

**In simple words:** Square tells n8n every time a booking changes.
- **New booking:** text the stylist.
- **Cancelled on time:** text the stylist, no fee.
- **Late cancel or no-show:** text the manager a link to **Charge** or **Waive** the fee. Nothing is charged automatically.

No-show = the stylist marks the appointment **No-show** in the Square app.
